look.why: A warm sun-bleached savanna straw yellow that evokes dry African grasslands and sets off the spotted tan coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 1.6 m (body 95–165 cm plus 25–36 cm tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Open savannas, grasslands, woodlands and semi-deserts across sub-Saharan Africa.

diet.text: Wildebeest, zebras, gazelles, warthogs and bones—hunting most of its own prey in coordinated clan groups.

facts.text: Spotted hyena clans are strict matriarchies where every female outranks every adult male.
Their bone-crushing jaws exert over 4,500 newtons of force, letting them digest bones, teeth and hooves.

id.habitat: Sabana terbuka, padang rumput, hutan jarang, dan semi-gurun di Afrika sub-Sahara.
id.diet: Wildebeest, zebra, gazel, babi hutan, dan tulang—berburu sebagian besar mangsanya secara berkelompok.
facts: Kelompok hiena tutul dipimpin oleh betina (matriarki ketat) di mana setiap betina memiliki kedudukan lebih tinggi dari jantan dewasa.
Rahang penghancur tulangnya menghasilkan kekuatan lebih dari 4.500 newton sehingga mampu mencerna tulang dan kuku mangsa.
